Pakistan cricket turmoil sparks criticism and player dismissals

After Pakistan's recent loss to India in a T20 series, PCB chief Mohsin Naqvi made remarks that provoked anger among Pakistani fans. Former England captain Nasser Hussain said Pakistan's current condition is the board's responsibility. Former Australian fast‑bowler Jason Gillespie criticized selector Akbar Javed for selection policy, lack of communication and a fear‑driven environment. A video showing Naqvi standing outside a London liquor store during an interview went viral on social media. PCB dismissed wicket‑keeper Mohammad Rizwan, bowler Imam Ul Haq and all‑rounder Salman Ali after the England tour, citing dressing‑room behaviour rather than performance. Indian media outlets previewed the upcoming India‑Pakistan T20 match in Dubai, noting the pitch conditions and potential records for players such as Smriti Mandhana and Harmanpreet Kaur.
